notes.title: NEWS AND SUPER DISCOUNTS!
notes.content:
Hello players.
We would like to share some news and good news with you ːsteamhappyː.

[h2]A LITTLE ABOUT THE GAMESBRAZ STORIES COLLETION SERIES[/h2]
Since we started here, we have made several games that make up the "GamesBraz Stories Collection" series.
We believe that the series achieved its goal, which was to provide small games, with short stories and cool mechanics, at a reasonable price for everyone.

We've received all your feedback, improved the bugs that the community reported to us, and made several releases in the series.
We gained fans and haters, praise and criticism, support and persecution, yet we never gave up on our mission.

We would like to thank everyone who has followed us this far, encouraging and helping, reporting bugs, giving suggestions and promoting our games.

To finish this season with a flourish, we announce the two games that will close the "GamesBraz Stories Collection" package, which will be: [b]Bank Robber[/b] and [b]The Killer[/b]!

We will end the "GamesBraz Stories Collection" series with these last two titles, however we are already planning a new series of games, which we will announce soon.

Of course, titles released in the "GamesBraz Stories Collection" series will continue to receive updates and support.

[h2]CELEBRATING WITH SUPER DISCOUNT[/h2]
To celebrate the arrival of the two new titles that will make up the "GamesBraz Stories Collection" series, we're putting all titles at a SUPER DISCOUNT ːsteammockingː!

Therefore, [b]it is the ideal time for you to complete your GamesBraz Stories Collection[/b].
[i]ːsteamthisːThis promotion will last until February 10th, enjoy!ːsteamthisː[/i]

[h2]BUNDLE GamesBraz Stories Collection[/h2]
If you still don't own all the GamesBraz Stories Collection games, you can [b]complete your collection for an extraordinarily good price[/b] with this bundle. Take a look:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/22233/GamesBraz_Stories_Collection/

[h2]LAUNCH - The Killer[/h2]
One of our most beloved titles, with incredible mechanics and a fantastic scenery.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1990280/The_Killer/
[i]Add to your wishlist![/i]

[h2]LAUNCH - Bank Robber[/h2]
The last title that will make up the GamesBraz Stories Collection series.
This title has several details in the scenario, surprising missions, new mechanics, and lots of fun. See more on the game page.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1990270/Bank_Robber/
[i]Add to your wishlist![/i]

[h2]OTHERS GAMES:[/h2]
See all of our other games on our Steam page.
https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/gamesbraz

notes.title: Small update - bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello, dear players.

We are here to inform you that we have made some basic corrections to this title.

Many players were reporting that achievements were often not being distributed, even if they finished the game. So our team worked to identify and resolve the issue.

We would like to inform you that, as of now, all achievements are working normally, and that they are distributed at the exact moment you perform the action for which the objective is to achieve it. If they are not distributed at the appropriate time, they will be distributed for sure at the end of the game.

We are working on further updates for all our titles.

If you have any suggestions, or want to report a bug/error, please send it to: [b]publisher.gamesbraz@gmail.com[/b]

Or, if you prefer, post about a suggestion/bug/error in our community hub, here on Steam. We're always on the lookout.

Have a good game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40701229/d61df6c7e046f7fa7c4d8576891992cf6ad0bd04.png[/img]
